name: LoyaltyLion
description: Understand your loyalty program setup, analyse your program performance over time and explore your member activity.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LoyaltyLion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LoyaltyLion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.loyaltylion.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LoyaltyLion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LoyaltyLion provides these MCP tools: describe_program_setup, get_customers, get_metric_series, get_orders, and search_knowledge.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LoyaltyLion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LoyaltyLion in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
LoyaltyLion requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LoyaltyLion is developed by LoyaltyLion. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
